collection.title: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07 (GPM_3IMERGM)

access: Earthdata Login (environment token); GES DISC OPeNDAP DAP4 server-side subset of /Grid/precipitation, one month at a time, in memory (no raw file kept)
regrid: mean of valid 0.1 degree cells in each 10 x 10 block (1 degree), kept if >= 50 of 100 valid; mm/hr x 24 = mm/day
note: Raw granules are not kept; only the 1-degree monthly derivative is shipped. No trend statistic is computed in the build.
